shadow:
inset 0 1px 0 var(--prisma-edge-top-governed),
    inset 1px 0 0 var(--prisma-edge-side-governed),
    inset -1px 0 0 var(--prisma-edge-cold-governed),
    inset 0 -1px 0 var(--prisma-edge-bottom-governed)

background:
linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.20), transparent 22%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%, rgba(255, 218, 142, 0.12), transparent 32%)

linear-gradient(180deg, var(--prisma-glass-edge-top), transparent 16%),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--prisma-glass-edge-side), transparent 18%, transparent 82%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--prisma-accent-cool-frosted-strong) 42%, transparent))

linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.74), rgba(217, 236, 246, 0.5)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%, rgba(255, 241, 200, 0.9), transparent 52%)

linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) 34%, transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 58% 4%, rgba(217, 154, 34, 0.18), transparent 8%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(174, 198, 210, 0.22), transparent 28%)

linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.028) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018) 1px, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 45%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38) 100%)

linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055) 34%, transparent 38%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 54% 6%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), transparent 5%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(232, 189, 103, 0.14), transparent 26%)

radial-gradient(circle at 50% -8%, rgba(255, 226, 156, 0.34), transparent 18%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 8%, rgba(190, 222, 238, 0.18), transparent 23%),
    linear-gradient(118deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075) 34%, transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 103%, rgba(232, 189, 103, 0.18), transparent 28%)

selector: html[data-layer-stage-haze="0"] body::before, html[data-layer-stage-haze="off"] body::before, html[data-layer-stage-haze="false"] body::before
html[data-layer-stage-noise="0"] body::after, html[data-layer-stage-noise="off"] body::after, html[data-layer-stage-noise="false"] body::after

html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="ProductCard"], html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="SecondaryActionCard"], html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="TerminalStatusCard"], html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="Toast"], html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="EmptyState"], html[data-theme="prisma-dark"] [data-prisma-component="ErrorState"]

html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="ProductCard"], html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="SecondaryActionCard"], html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="TerminalStatusCard"], html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="Toast"], html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="EmptyState"], html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="ErrorState"]

background:
linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 250, 232, 0.18), transparent 22%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 0%, rgba(255, 217, 143, 0.16), transparent 38%),
    linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.075) 36%, transparent 46%)
selector: html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="Sidebar"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="TopBar"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="SearchBar"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="CartPanel"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="ProductCard"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="SecondaryActionCard"]::before, html[data-theme] [data-prisma-component="TerminalStatusCard"]::before
